documents.title: Artificial Intelligence (USM AI Syllabus Policy; AI Usage Policy for Instruction)
documents.stance_why: The page sets no single stance: "Each instructor will determine the permitted use of artificial intelligence in each course" and it offers three options (Encouraged Use, Permissible Use, Human-Generated Work Only) as syllabus templates, so the stance is delegates with tiers.
documents.summary: The Provost's page and syllabus policy require each course to state an AI policy and offer three usage options (encouraged, permissible, human-only); it says each instructor determines permitted use. The page also describes workshops, grants and the AI Taskforce, and links the Responsible Use guidelines.

documents.unit: Office of the Provost / AI Taskforce
documents.title: USM Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence Guidelines
documents.stance_why: The guidelines set institution-wide principles but for coursework say "The faculty will provide specific guidelines on permissible AI use in coursework" and "faculty must approve its use", so no single student-use stance is set; delegates.
documents.summary: Guidelines (Jan 2025) for ethical, secure use of AI by all students, faculty and staff, covering data privacy, accountability, human oversight, acceptable and prohibited uses, research, training and sanctions. For coursework it defers to faculty.

units.why: "establish a framework for the ethical, secure, and responsible use of AI at USM" states the purpose of an institution-wide framework, so P56.
units.anchor: These guidelines establish a framework for the ethical, secure, and responsible use of AI

units.why: "These guidelines apply to all students, faculty, staff, and affiliated individuals" defines who the guidelines bind, so P61 (scope).
units.anchor: apply to all students, faculty, staff, and affiliated individuals

units.why: "AI output should be critically evaluated particularly in areas like admissions, grading, or hiring" names bias risk and tells users to evaluate, so P53, should.
units.anchor: AI systems may reflect biases that can lead to discrimination or unequal treatment

units.why: "AI decisions with significant consequences must involve human oversight" requires human review of consequential decisions, so P73, must.
units.anchor: AI decisions with significant consequences must involve human oversight

units.why: "informed consent is required" when AI systems interact directly with people means people must be told they deal with AI and agree, so P103, must.
units.anchor: informed consent is required

units.why: "Individuals should have the option to opt out without facing negative consequences" gives an opt-out; nearest P103, but it adds an opt-out right, so fit_note.
units.anchor: option to opt out without facing negative consequences
units.fit_note: Adds a right to opt out without penalty, not only a right to know.

units.why: "Students should disclose AI assistance where applicable" asks students to disclose, so P24, should.
units.anchor: Students should disclose AI assistance where applicable

units.why: "faculty must approve its use for coursework, supervised research, and examinations" makes AI use depend on prior faculty approval, so P107 (prior approval), restrict.
units.anchor: faculty must approve its use for coursework, supervised research, and examinations

units.why: "Avoid using high-risk data (e.g., student records, confidential research) unless verified secure by iTech" protects sensitive data, so P50, should-not.
units.anchor: Avoid using high-risk data (e.g., student records, confidential research) unless verified secure by iTech

units.why: "Personally identifiable information (PII) must be removed from datasets before AI analysis" is a data-protection rule, so P50, must.
units.anchor: Personally identifiable information (PII) must be removed from datasets before AI analysis

units.why: "AI use must adhere to applicable data privacy laws and regulations, including FERPA and HIPAA" requires legal compliance, so P77.
units.anchor: AI use must adhere to applicable data privacy laws and regulations, including FERPA and HIPAA

units.why: "Limit data collection to what is strictly necessary" is a data-minimization duty, so P50, should.
units.anchor: Limit data collection to what is strictly necessary for AI application

units.why: "Follow USM's information security protocols to safeguard AI data" ties AI use to existing security policy, so P77, should.
units.anchor: Follow USM’s information security protocols to safeguard AI

units.why: "Any data shared externally for AI use must comply with USM data policies, with explicit authorization" limits sharing data with AI providers, so P65, must.
units.anchor: Any data shared externally for AI use must comply with USM data policies

units.why: "AI users and developers are accountable for verifying AI generated outputs" puts verification duty on users, so P31, must.
units.anchor: AI users and developers are accountable for verifying AI
units.frag_end: final decisions particularly in administrative functions and evaluations.

units.why: "Regularly assess AI systems for performance, security vulnerabilities, and ethical considerations" calls for monitoring of AI systems, so P98, should.
units.anchor: Regularly assess AI systems for performance, security vulnerabilities, and ethical considerations

units.why: "promptly report any issues or malfunctions to the AI Incident Database (AIID), any required regulatory bodies, or the iTech Help Desk" creates a reporting duty, so P71, must.
units.anchor: promptly report any issues or malfunctions to the AI Incident Database (AIID)

units.why: "Inform users when AI is involved in decision making processes" tells people when AI is in use, so P103, should.
units.anchor: Inform users when AI is involved in decision making processes

units.why: "generating content drafts, language translations, or creating study materials" permits low-risk uses; nearest P14 (study aids) but also drafts and translation, so fit_note.
units.anchor: generating content drafts, language translations, or creating study materials
units.fit_note: Also permits content drafts and translation, broader than study aids.

units.why: "provided outputs are reviewed by a human" conditions the low-risk uses on human review of output, so P31, must.
units.anchor: provided outputs are reviewed by a human

units.why: "AI should not be used for tasks requiring accuracy and fairness" bars unsupervised AI in high-stakes evaluation, so P73 (decisions about people), should-not.
units.anchor: AI should not be used for tasks requiring accuracy and fairness
units.fit_note: Also covers grading, which P46/P101 treat separately.

units.why: "final accountability rests with staff" assigns responsibility for administrative AI use to staff, so P76 (administrative AI), informs.
units.anchor: AI can enhance administrative processes, but final accountability rests with staff
units.frag_end: significantly affect individuals without human review.

units.why: "AI-driven administrative tools are accessible to all members of the USM community" requires accessible administrative AI, so P97.
units.anchor: AI-driven administrative tools are accessible to all members of the USM community

units.why: "AI tools used for educational purposes should enhance, not replace, learning" says AI must not displace learning, so P32, should.
units.anchor: AI tools used for educational purposes should enhance, not replace, learning

units.why: "Faculty are encouraged to integrate AI thoughtfully into curricula while preserving core learning objectives" encourages faculty to use AI in teaching; nearest P02, fit_note.
units.anchor: Faculty are encouraged to integrate AI thoughtfully into curricula
units.fit_note: Addressed to faculty curriculum design and tied to preserving learning objectives (P83).

units.why: "AI tools used for coursework must be cited appropriately" makes citation mandatory, so P24, must.
units.anchor: AI tools used for coursework must be cited appropriately
units.frag_start: AI tools used for coursework must

units.anchor: AI may be used in research provided it aligns with these guidelines
units.frag_start: AI may be used in research

units.why: "Ensure that AI research complies with institutional review board (IRB) protocols, ethical standards, and sponsor imposed contractual requirements" defers to IRB and sponsor rules, so P62, must.
units.anchor: Ensure that AI research complies with institutional review board (IRB) protocols

units.why: "Researchers must consult with any intended journals and their editors on their policies" defers to venue rules, so P62, must.
units.anchor: Researchers must consult with any intended journals and their editors

units.why: "Students must adhere to academic integrity policies when using AI" ties student AI use to existing integrity policy, so P77, must.
units.anchor: Students must adhere to academic integrity policies when using AI

units.why: "The faculty will provide specific guidelines on permissible AI use in coursework" delegates course rules to faculty, so P04.
units.anchor: The faculty will provide specific guidelines on permissible AI use in coursework

units.why: "AI should complement, not substitute, critical thinking and problem-solving" keeps students as the thinkers, so P32, should.
units.anchor: AI should complement, not substitute, critical thinking and problem-solving

units.why: "AI must not be used for illegal, unethical, or policy violating activities" is a general conduct ban on malicious use, so P74, must-not.
units.anchor: AI must not be used for illegal, unethical, or policy violating activities

units.why: "AI tools must not be used to access or manipulate data without authorization" bans unauthorized data access, so P74, must-not.
units.anchor: AI tools must not be used to access or manipulate data without authorization

units.why: "AI generated content that violates intellectual property rights is prohibited" concerns IP of AI output, so P52, must-not.
units.anchor: AI generated content that violates intellectual property rights is prohibited

units.why: "Unauthorized surveillance of students or staff using AI is not permitted" bans AI surveillance; no type covers surveillance, so UNCOVERED.
units.anchor: Unauthorized surveillance of students or staff using AI is not permitted
units.uncovered_note: AI must not be used for unauthorized surveillance or monitoring of students or staff.

units.why: "AI systems reinforcing biases or discrimination must be corrected through regular assessments and mitigation strategies" requires correction after bias audits, so P98, must.
units.anchor: AI systems reinforcing biases or discrimination must be corrected through regular assessments

units.why: "Use of generative AI in accreditation should be done by users who are familiar with the concepts and constraints" governs administrative accreditation work, so P76, should.
units.anchor: Use of generative AI in accreditation should be done by users who are familiar
units.frag_start: Use of generative AI in accreditation

units.why: "Training ... is the responsibility of each AI user and should be completed before using AI tools" requires AI training, so P70, should.
units.anchor: is the responsibility of each AI user and should be completed before using AI tools

units.why: "Students, faculty, and staff are encouraged to take advantage of training both internal and external" encourages training, so P70.
units.anchor: Students, faculty, and staff are encouraged to take advantage of training

units.why: "found to have violated these guidelines may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including suspension, expulsion, and/or termination" names escalating sanctions, so P37.
units.anchor: may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including suspension, expulsion, and/or termination

units.why: External entities in violation "may be held in breach of contract" is a contract sanction for non-members; nearest P37, fit_note.
units.anchor: may be held in breach of contract
units.frag_start: External Entities: Any external entity, contractor, consultant, or temporary
units.fit_note: Concerns contractors and vendors, not students or employees.

units.why: "These guidelines will be reviewed annually" sets a review cycle, so P54.
units.anchor: These guidelines will be reviewed annually

units.why: "Community feedback is encouraged for continuous improvement" invites feedback, so P54.
units.anchor: encouraged for continuous improvement

units.why: "2025-01-31 - Initial publication." records when the guidelines were first adopted, so P84.
units.anchor: 2025-01-31 - Initial publication.
